reference: src/mcp/mcp_access.c and access declarations in src/mcp/mcp_broker_internal.h

limits.accepted_path_bytes: 1..1023 raw OsStr bytes; interior NUL is rejected. Public methods accept impl AsRef<OsStr>, including existing str callers, with no lossy UTF-8 conversion

ownership.policy: AccessPolicy owns Option<OsString> allowed directories, Option<PathBuf> home, and captures current uid at construction
ownership.environment_adapter: from_environment snapshots VEXEL_MCP_ALLOWED_DIRS and HOME; no later process-global reads
ownership.results: Resolved paths are owned PathBuf values; raw OsStr input is borrowed only for each call
ownership.config_reader: File and fixed-size stack line buffer are locally owned; no unbounded line allocation

symbols.behavior: Canonicalize and require an existing regular file; canonical symlink target is returned.
Only a resolved regular file inside an environment or secure config grant is allowed. Directory boundaries are component-aware, including root.
symbols.errors: Returns false for any resolution, config, or grant denial.

symbols.behavior: Existing targets use existing-file canonicalization and grant checks. ENOENT targets require a valid leaf, canonical existing directory parent, bounded output, and grant.
Canonicalize and require a directory inside an environment or secure config grant.
Requires canonical absolute directory and output below PATH_CAP.
Prefix plus separator boundary; `/` grants absolute descendants.
Colon splitting and bounded values; config uses non-following metadata validation, current uid, no group/other write, and a bounded reader.

adaptations: C bool/output-buffer APIs are safe Rust methods returning owned PathBuf or AccessError; path_allowed remains a bool predicate.
All path APIs accept impl AsRef<OsStr>; path byte length, NUL validation, and save leaf splitting use raw Unix/macOS bytes, preserving non-UTF-8 names without lossy conversion.
Environment and home values are explicit owned policy inputs, with a production snapshot adapter, avoiding test mutation of global environment.
Native user identity comes from accepted vexel_platform_macos::current_uid; Unix metadata extensions are used only within the locked macOS target.
C realpath/stat and lstat/fopen sequences are represented by safe std filesystem calls; check-then-use races remain as in the reference and are documented.
No caller atomic-publication wiring is included; save-path resolution only returns the authorized destination.

The real non-UTF-8 fixture retains its original success assertions when native creation succeeds. On EILSEQ (errno 92) or PermissionDenied, it asserts actual native canonicalize/stat errors, exact raw API denials or save resolution implied by native ENOENT, NUL as InvalidPath, no lossy rewrite to a real U+FFFD-named file, and inside/outside grants. The worker observed EPERM at creation; root reported EILSEQ. No skip or mock is used.
Pre-correction source and verification are archived as pre-correction-access.rs and pre-correction-verification.txt; root errno evidence is in root-host-failure-evidence.txt.
